title: Sean McVay on Puka Nacua injury: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't questioning that play call

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay on Puka Nacua injury: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't questioning that play call
sources.description: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is set to go on injured reserve after suffering MCL, PCL and turf toe injuries in Sunday's win over the Commanders.
